quest.endrealms.title: Endwalker's Guide
quest.endrealms.enter_end.title: The Gate
quest.endrealms.enter_end.desc: Find a stronghold and step through the End Portal. Lost this guide? A book and a piece of end stone make a new one.
quest.endrealms.dragon.title: The Old Ruler
quest.endrealms.dragon.desc: The End Realms only open up once the dragon is gone.
quest.endrealms.gateway.title: Beyond the Gateway
quest.endrealms.gateway.desc: Throw an ender pearl into the gateway at the edge of the main island. The outer islands wait behind it.
quest.endrealms.end_city.title: Towers of Purpur
quest.endrealms.end_city.desc: The old End Cities still stand among the islands.
quest.endrealms.elytra.title: Wings
quest.endrealms.elytra.desc: An elytra hangs on the ships of the End Cities. Nothing crosses the void faster.
quest.endrealms.forest.title: Astral Forest
quest.endrealms.forest.desc: Tall thin trees on purple soil, the gentlest place in the End.
quest.endrealms.forest.goal: Set foot in an Astral Forest
quest.endrealms.astral_wood.title: Timber
quest.endrealms.astral_wood.desc: Astral wood builds nearly everything the End's villagers live in.
quest.endrealms.glimmerhoof.title: Glimmerhoof Hunt
quest.endrealms.glimmerhoof.desc: Glimmerhoofs graze under the canopy. Their meat keeps well.
quest.endrealms.glimmer_ride.title: Leap of Faith
quest.endrealms.glimmer_ride.desc: Put a saddle on a grown Glimmerhoof and ride it. Hold jump and let go: it leaps far higher than a horse, and its long legs take the fall.
quest.endrealms.starberry.title: Falling Star
quest.endrealms.starberry.desc: Starreed grows only here. Its berries slow your fall and quicken your step. Planted on End Soil a berry grows a new cane; shears take the cane itself.
quest.endrealms.nectar.title: Moonbell
quest.endrealms.nectar.desc: The nectar of the Moonbell lets you see in the dark. Planted on End Soil it grows a new Moonbell; shears take the whole plant.
quest.endrealms.basin.title: Astral Basin
quest.endrealms.basin.desc: A ring of mountains around a glowing lake.
quest.endrealms.basin.goal: Set foot in an Astral Basin
quest.endrealms.fishing.title: Astral Angler
quest.endrealms.fishing.desc: Astral water only gives End fish. Cooked, they help you dive: Starfin to swim, Void Eel to breathe, Glowgill for both.
quest.endrealms.fishing.goal: Catch a fish in astral water
quest.endrealms.lurker.title: Something Below
quest.endrealms.lurker.desc: Deep Lurkers hunt anything swimming in the deep. Every bite takes your breath.
quest.endrealms.deepglow.title: Light of the Deep
quest.endrealms.deepglow.desc: Deepglow Ore shines only on the deep lake bed.
quest.endrealms.prism.title: Prism Wastes
quest.endrealms.prism.desc: Turquoise crystal spires on pale ground.
quest.endrealms.prism.goal: Set foot in the Prism Wastes
quest.endrealms.prism_shards.title: Crystal Harvest
quest.endrealms.prism_shards.desc: Most later recipes want Prism Shards.
quest.endrealms.shardcrab.title: Not a Crystal
quest.endrealms.shardcrab.desc: Some of those crystals have legs.
quest.endrealms.scorched.title: Scorched Barrens
quest.endrealms.scorched.desc: Hilly islands under ash that piles up like snow, and small volcanoes that never stop smoking.
quest.endrealms.scorched.goal: Set foot in the Scorched Barrens
quest.endrealms.wraith.title: Ashes to Ashes
quest.endrealms.wraith.desc: Ash Wraiths spit embers and leave a blinding cloud when they die.
quest.endrealms.ash_meal.title: From Ashes
quest.endrealms.ash_meal.desc: Nine piles of Ash Dust make Ash Meal, far stronger than bone meal.
quest.endrealms.vent.title: Bottled Eruption
quest.endrealms.vent.desc: A Volcanic Vent burns whatever stands near it, a fine trap. Redstone shuts it off.
quest.endrealms.graveyard.title: Dragon Graveyard
quest.endrealms.graveyard.desc: Pale islands where old dragons came to die. Their ribcages still stand, and some skulls hide a chest.
quest.endrealms.graveyard.goal: Set foot in a Dragon Graveyard
quest.endrealms.whelp.title: Laid to Rest
quest.endrealms.whelp.desc: Spectral Whelps circle above the bones, then swoop at anything that walks among them.
quest.endrealms.dragon_bones.title: Old Bones
quest.endrealms.dragon_bones.desc: Whelps and graveyard chests give Dragon Bone. Nine make a block, one makes a lot of bone meal.
quest.endrealms.drake.title: Dragon Tamer
quest.endrealms.drake.desc: A small Bone Drake sits in a nest of bone at the heart of every graveyard, and nothing can hurt it. Feed it Dragon Bones until it takes to you; then it follows you through the air like a dog and fights at your side. Right-click it with an empty hand to make it sit or stand, and Dragon Bones heal it.
quest.endrealms.village.title: Foreign Market
quest.endrealms.village.desc: End Villagers trade for Chorusite Shards, and do not care for emeralds.
quest.endrealms.trade.title: A Fair Deal
quest.endrealms.trade.desc: Their prices are honest, if not cheap.
quest.endrealms.bastion.title: Void Bastion
quest.endrealms.bastion.desc: Towers of voidstone full of guards and chests.
quest.endrealms.sentinel.title: Sentry Duty Over
quest.endrealms.sentinel.desc: Void Sentinels hit hard and come in numbers.
quest.endrealms.template.title: The Upgrade Template
quest.endrealms.template.desc: Bastion chests hold the template that turns netherite into Chorusite.
quest.endrealms.observatory.title: Stargazer
quest.endrealms.observatory.desc: Ruined towers with great telescopes, libraries full of gem materials.
quest.endrealms.wreck.title: Adrift
quest.endrealms.wreck.desc: Ships float in the void. Their decks are rotten, so keep moving. A Castaway may sell rare goods.
quest.endrealms.wreck.goal: Set foot on a Sky Wreck
quest.endrealms.crypt.title: Under the Ash
quest.endrealms.crypt.desc: A spiral stair leads beneath every tomb on the Scorched Barrens.
quest.endrealms.crypt_guards.title: Tomb Sweeper
quest.endrealms.crypt_guards.desc: The wraiths guarding the burial chambers will not leave on their own.
quest.endrealms.shards.title: Chorusite
quest.endrealms.shards.desc: The ore hides inside the islands, and only a netherite pickaxe can break it.
quest.endrealms.pure.title: Refining
quest.endrealms.pure.desc: Four shards, four diamonds and one piece of phasite.
quest.endrealms.ingot.title: The Chorusite Age
quest.endrealms.ingot.desc: Smelt the refined shard into an ingot.
quest.endrealms.pickaxe.title: Sharper than Netherite
quest.endrealms.pickaxe.desc: The template and an ingot turn a netherite pickaxe into a Chorusite one.
quest.endrealms.armor.title: Clad in the End
quest.endrealms.armor.desc: Stronger than netherite, and you will need it at the end of this road.
quest.endrealms.armor.goal: Obtain a full Chorusite armor set
quest.endrealms.chorusite_block.title: Monument of the End
quest.endrealms.chorusite_block.desc: Nine ingots pressed into one glowing block. Worth more than anything else you can build, and a beacon accepts it.
quest.endrealms.end_table.title: Five by Five
quest.endrealms.end_table.desc: The End's greater items are crafted on a 5x5 grid. Its window lists every such recipe: click one to see where everything goes, and the table fills the grid from your inventory when you have it all.
quest.endrealms.phasite.title: Out of Phase
quest.endrealms.phasite.desc: A rare ore on the undersides of the islands.
quest.endrealms.pearl.title: Pocket Rift
quest.endrealms.pearl.desc: A pearl that remembers one place.
quest.endrealms.anchor.title: Anchored
quest.endrealms.anchor.desc: Right-click an anchor with the pearl to bind them, then jump to it from anywhere.
quest.endrealms.table.title: The Gem Table
quest.endrealms.table.desc: Tools, weapons and armor can each hold one gem.
quest.endrealms.gem.title: Cut and Polished
quest.endrealms.gem.desc: Each gem gives something else to each kind of item. Hover over one to see.
quest.endrealms.socket.title: Set in Stone
quest.endrealms.socket.desc: Put an item and a gem in the table. Taking a gem out destroys it.
quest.endrealms.socket.goal: Set a gem into an item
quest.endrealms.all_gems.title: Master Jeweler
quest.endrealms.all_gems.desc: Own every kind of gem at least once.
quest.endrealms.canvas.title: Blank Canvas
quest.endrealms.canvas.desc: Nine white wool make a Canvas. Right-click its front with any dye to paint the pixel you look at; sneak with an empty hand to scrape one off. Broken, it keeps the picture.
quest.endrealms.large_canvas.title: Bigger Picture
quest.endrealms.large_canvas.desc: Two canvases make one twice as wide. It needs a free spot to the right of where you place it.
quest.endrealms.backpack.title: More Room
quest.endrealms.backpack.desc: Five leather and a string make a Backpack. Put it in the slot above your off hand for nine more slots under your inventory.
quest.endrealms.fermentation_station.des: Copper, iron, glass and a barrel make a Fermentation Station. Fruit goes on top, glass bottles below, and pour water in with a bucket (up to ten); every bottle takes one bucket. Hoppers can fill it from above and the sides and empty it from below.
quest.endrealms.apple_brandy.title: Apple Brandy
quest.endrealms.apple_brandy.desc: Six apples, a bottle and a bucket of water ferment into Apple Brandy in five minutes. It makes you strong, but the world sways just as long, and it makes you drunk. Another glass before that wears off makes it worse, up to level four.
quest.endrealms.brandy_master.title: Master Distiller
quest.endrealms.brandy_master.desc: Twelve glow berries make Glow Berry Brandy (night vision, haste), twelve sweet berries Sweet Berry Brandy (speed), four Moonbell Nectars a Nectar Brandy (resistance, fire resistance), eight Starberries a Starberry Brandy (jump boost, slow falling).
quest.endrealms.aging_barrel.title: Patience
quest.endrealms.aging_barrel.desc: Dark oak logs, iron and a barrel make an Aging Barrel. It holds one bottle of brandy in each of its three slots. After a Minecraft day (20 minutes) a bottle becomes Aged, after a day and a half more Fine Old: longer effects and higher levels. It only ages while its chunk is loaded; taking a bottle out starts its time over. Hoppers fill it from above and the sides and take only finished bottles from below.
quest.endrealms.fine_brandy.title: Well Aged
quest.endrealms.fine_brandy.desc: Age any brandy to the finest quality (three stars).
quest.endrealms.fine_brandy.goal: Age a brandy to three stars
quest.endrealms.fruit_medley_brandy.desc: Four apples and six sweet berries: strength and speed. Plus a bottle and a bucket of water, as always.
quest.endrealms.honeyed_apple_brandy.des: Four apples and two honey bottles: regeneration and a thick layer of absorption. Plus a bottle and a bucket of water, as always.
quest.endrealms.glowing_nectar_brandy.de: Eight glow berries and two Moonbell Nectars: night vision, resistance, and every monster nearby glows through the walls for half a minute. Plus a bottle and a bucket of water, as always.
quest.endrealms.chorus_berry_brandy.desc: Four chorus fruits and four Starberries: slow falling and high jumps for hopping between islands. Plus a bottle and a bucket of water, as always.
quest.endrealms.melon_refresher.title: Melon Refresher
quest.endrealms.melon_refresher.desc: Eight melon slices and six sweet berries: fire resistance, water breathing and four hearts at once. Plus a bottle and a bucket of water, as always.
quest.endrealms.endless_brandy.title: Endless
quest.endrealms.endless_brandy.desc: Three Moonbell Nectars, four Starberries and six glow berries: you float up for a few seconds, then drift down with high jumps and speed. Plus a bottle and a bucket of water, as always.
quest.endrealms.miners_brandy.title: Miner's Friend
quest.endrealms.miners_brandy.desc: Four apples, eight glow berries and a golden carrot: Haste II and night vision. Plus a bottle and a bucket of water, as always.
quest.endrealms.dragon_blood_brandy.desc: A Dragon Bone, four apples and three Moonbell Nectars: Strength II, fire resistance and resistance. Plus a bottle and a bucket of water, as always.
quest.endrealms.forest_elixir.title: Forest Elixir
quest.endrealms.forest_elixir.desc: Six sweet berries, two honey bottles and two cocoa beans: Speed II and a full stomach. Plus a bottle and a bucket of water, as always.
quest.endrealms.void_essence.title: Void Essence
quest.endrealms.void_essence.desc: Four chorus fruits, an eye of ender and three Starberries: invisibility and slow falling. Plus a bottle and a bucket of water, as always.
quest.endrealms.mix_master.title: Master of Blends
quest.endrealms.mix_master.desc: Brew every one of the ten mixed brandies.
quest.endrealms.mailbox.title: Return to Sender
quest.endrealms.mailbox.desc: A Phase Anchor at its heart sends items to any named Phase Mailbox on the server, even in unloaded lands. Name yours in its window; hoppers can empty it.
quest.endrealms.gravity_stone.title: Feather Fall
quest.endrealms.gravity_stone.desc: Powered by redstone, it makes everything within six blocks fall slowly and jump high. Build lifts, jump courses and safe landings with it.
quest.endrealms.sanctum.title: Stairs into the Dark
quest.endrealms.sanctum.desc: A rare small shrine hides a stair down to an arena.
quest.endrealms.rift_lord.title: The Rift Closes
quest.endrealms.rift_lord.desc: It steps behind you and opens rifts underfoot. At 60% Void Sentinels shield it, at 25% it drags you in.
quest.endrealms.riftblade.title: Rift in Hand
quest.endrealms.riftblade.desc: Forged from the Rift Heart, it carries you nine blocks along your line of sight.
quest.endrealms.citadel.title: Castle in the Void
quest.endrealms.citadel.desc: Far out in the End a castle stands alone on its own island, with smaller islands chained around it. Each of those holds guards and chests.
quest.endrealms.citadel.goal: Set foot on a Void Citadel's island
quest.endrealms.citadel_guards.title: Storming the Walls
quest.endrealms.citadel_guards.desc: Sentinels hold the courtyard and halls, and Ash Wraiths shoot down from the walls.
quest.endrealms.void_king.title: Regicide
quest.endrealms.void_king.desc: Fights like the Rift Lord and hits harder. Jump over his shockwaves. His death opens the sealed treasury under the throne room.
quest.endrealms.crownstone.title: Heavy Is the Crown
quest.endrealms.crownstone.desc: Only the Void King carries Crownstones. Set in the Gem Table, one does the work of two ordinary gems.
